description: The **Daily Standup Timer** track will implement a real-time facilitation module designed to help agile teams run focused ceremonies through structured speaker queues and a hybrid client-server countdown system. Leveraging the existing Convex infrastructure, this track involves establishing specialized data models for speaker entries and parking lot items, while introducing a "high-juice" neo-brutalist interface that seamlessly transitions from room setup to live timeboxing and ephemeral session summaries. Technical milestones include building the precision timer logic that handles pauses and auto-advances without excessive server writes, creating responsive speaker queue management with drag-and-drop reordering, and updating the landing hub to support the new `/standup/:slug` route, ultimately delivering a zero-friction "second screen" experience that keeps team syncs efficient and engaging.
